it.txt: Presidente da Câmara Municipal, assumiu a prefeitura de forma interina em 17/06/2026, em sessão solene da Câmara que declarou vagos os cargos de prefeito e vice, depois que a Justiça Eleitoral cassou a chapa eleita em 2024. Na eleição suplementar de 25/10/2026, foram eleitos Beto Leite (UNIÃO), prefeito, e Fernanda Crepaldi (UNIÃO), vice, com posse marcada para 26/11/2026.
it.txt_en: As president of the City Council, he became acting mayor on June 17, 2026, in a formal session of the City Council that declared the offices of mayor and vice mayor vacant, after the Electoral Courts revoked the ticket elected in 2024. In the special election held on October 25, 2026, Beto Leite (UNIÃO) was elected mayor and Fernanda Crepaldi (UNIÃO) vice mayor; their swearing-in is scheduled for November 26, 2026.

it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e assumiu a prefeitura em 01/04/2026, depois que Beto Vizzotto renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a deputado estadual na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and took over as mayor on April 1, 2026, after Mayor Beto Vizzotto resigned to run for state deputy in the 2026 election.
